paper_title: Streamflow Simulation in Data-Scarce Basins Using Bayesian and Physics-Informed Machine Learning Models
evidence_summary: The paper's Data Availability Statement says that the short records from headwater gauging stations in the East River Watershed are available on ESS-DIVE. The Stage-1 host form omits the hyphen; the current official repository is ess-dive.lbl.gov.
evidence_location: Data Availability Statement; official ESS-DIVE repository landing/documentation

paper_title: HypoSVI: Hypocentre inversion with Stein variational inference and physics informed neural networks
evidence_summary: The paper states that earthquake phase arrival and station locations can be downloaded from the Southern California Earthquake Data Center and applies the method to SCEDC phase-arrival observations. The Stage-1 scdec.caltech.edu form is corrected to the official scedc.caltech.edu host.
evidence_location: Data Availability and Southern California case-study sections; official SCEDC data/service pages

paper_title: PINNup: Robust Neural Network Wavefield Solutions Using Frequency Upscaling and Neuron Splitting
evidence_summary: The paper's Data Availability Statement explicitly states that the datasets in the paper are available at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6637469. Zenodo independently identifies the deposit as the relevant PINNup dataset.
evidence_location: Data Availability Statement; Zenodo record description
